tool_input.command:
cd features/regression/step_definitions && for f in *.ts; do
  grep -oE "^(Given|When|Then)\(\s*['\"\`]" "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1
  grep -oE "(Given|When|Then)\(\s*'[^']*'|(Given|When|Then)\(\s*\"[^\"]*\"" "$f" | sed "s/^/$f: /"
done | sort -t: -k2 > /tmp/all_steps.txt
echo "--- total step registrations ---"
wc -l /tmp/all_steps.txt
echo "--- checking for duplicate phrase text across files ---"
sed -E "s/^[^:]+: (Given|When|Then)\(\s*['\"\`]//; s/['\"\`]$//" /tmp/all_steps.txt | sort | uniq -d
